verdict.rationale: ADP's own package docs say RUN can export journal entries into QuickBooks, Xero, Wave, Creative Solutions or a generic output file without re-keying data, which covers the target accounting systems. The evidence describes an export, though, not an automatic or continuous sync, so the 'automatically' part of the story is unproven. API Central is only a developer building block and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: evidence of automatic/scheduled sync rather than export, details on GL account mapping and how the integration works, independent or hands-on corroboration.
